Commentary of King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar) on surah 82, verses 1–5:

Name of the Surah

• It is called al-Infitar (the Cleaving), because it opens with mention of the cleaving of the sky (infitar al-sama'), meaning its splitting open and the disruption of its order, which is among the terrors of the Day of Resurrection.

Some Objectives of the Surah

• Mention of the scene of transformation that takes place at the establishment of the Hour, what follows it of reckoning and recompense, and an explanation of the division of people in the Hereafter into two groups: the righteous (abrar) and the wicked (fujjar), and the destiny of each of the two groups.

• Rebuke of man for his denial of his Lord's blessings upon him. Implicit in this is the awakening of the polytheists from their heedlessness regarding the Tawhid of Allah and from reflecting on the signs of the occurrence of resurrection and recompense, and a reminder of them of the guardian angels who record their deeds.

[Tafsir]

When the sky is split open and its order is disrupted; and when the stars fall and scatter; and when the seas are set aflame, Allah causing some of them to flow into others, so that their water is gone; and when the graves are overturned by the raising of those who were in them, then every soul will know all that it has done, what it sent forward and what it left behind, and it will be recompensed for it.

Commentary of King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar) on surah 82, verse 13:

Indeed, the righteous, who fulfil their duties to Allah and their duties to His servants, will surely be in bliss.

Indeed, the wicked, who fell short in their duties to Allah and to His servants, will be in the Blazing Fire (Jaḥīm). Its flame will afflict them on the Day of Recompense, and they will not be absent from the punishment of Hell, neither through escape nor through death.

Commentary of the King Fahd Complex (al-Tafsir al-Muyassar, a simplified Qur'anic exegesis) on Surah 82, verses 17–19:

And what will make you know what the Day of Judgment is? Then, what will make you know what the greatness of the Day of Judgment is? On the Day of Judgment, no one will be able to benefit anyone, and the command on that Day belongs to Allah alone, who cannot be overcome by any conqueror, cannot be subdued by any subduer, and whom no one can contend with.
